name: Monsterpalooza
blurb: A makeup-effects and horror convention at the Pasadena Convention Center, with special-effects demos, panels, vendors and horror guests.
notes: monsterpalooza.com's nav, homepage, tickets, showtimes and events pages are all currently branded for the Oct 2026 Son of Monsterpalooza / Burbank show (see son-of-monsterpalooza.json) - none mention a 2027 date for the main spring Pasadena edition. A web search (query: "Monsterpalooza 2027 Pasadena dates") found the most recent confirmed Monsterpalooza ran 29-31 May 2026 at the Pasadena Convention Center, already concluded before this run's window; no 2027 dates were found anywhere, so editions is empty and that show is recorded in "last" instead. Cover falls back to the generic brand logo (alt="Monsterpalooza") since the homepage's own key art is all for the Son of Monsterpalooza edition. Guests not checked since there is no upcoming edition to attach them to.
